title: Annotations
description: Catalog of conventional annotation fields skill-map ships out of the box, written into the `annotations:` block of a sidecar (`<basename>.sm`). Every field is OPTIONAL — a sidecar with an empty `annotations: {}` is valid. Schema is `additionalProperties: true` so users / plugins can add custom keys without coordination; the built-in `unknown-field` rule emits a warning on unrecognized keys (typo guard). Conventional fields are documented here so editors get autocomplete + doc-on-hover. Plugins that want first-class custom keys with their own validation declare `annotationContributions` in their manifest (see Step 9.6.6).

version.description: Monotonic counter. Bumped via the built-in `bump` Action when the underlying node changes meaningfully. Orthogonal to `stability` — `stability` carries the lifecycle stage; `version` is just a counter. There is no major: a change so big it would justify a major bump uses the convention `create a new node, supersede the old one` instead. Default: missing == unversioned.

stability.description: Lifecycle stage. Denormalized into `scan_nodes.stability` for fast queries (see `node.schema.json` #/properties/stability). Default: missing == unspecified.

supersedes.description: Paths (relative to scope root) of nodes this node replaces. Consumed by the built-in `superseded` rule and surfaces in `sm list --superseded`.

supersededBy.description: Path (relative to scope root) of the node that replaces this one. When set, the current node is end-of-life and consumers should migrate.

requires.description: Paths (relative to scope root) of nodes this node depends on. Surfaces in the dependency graph; the `broken-ref` rule flags missing targets.

conflictsWith.description: Paths (relative to scope root) of nodes that cannot be active alongside this one. Surfaces in conflict detection (post-v0.5.0).

provides.description: Free-form capability strings this node exposes. Consumed by Rules / Actions that match on capability rather than path.

related.description: Paths (relative to scope root) of conceptually related nodes. Soft link for navigation; no strong semantics, no rule enforcement.

type.description: Free-form sub-type within the Provider's kind (e.g. `review-skill`, `security-audit`). Distinct from `node.kind` (Provider-assigned) — `type` is author-assigned taxonomy.

author.description: Single-author display string. Denormalized into `scan_nodes.author` for fast queries.

authors.description: Multi-author list. When both `author` and `authors` are present, `author` is the display lead and `authors` is the canonical list.

source.description: URL of the canonical upstream (e.g. GitHub raw URL). Consumed by the `github-enrichment` Action for hash verification.

sourceVersion.description: Tag, branch, or full commit SHA at the upstream. Drives `github-enrichment` SHA pin / tag resolution.

created.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime (e.g. `2026-05-05`, `2026-05-05T10:30:00Z`). Author-managed; skill-map's audit trail tracks the sidecar's own write time separately under `audit:`.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime. Author-managed; the `bump` Action does NOT auto-touch this — it is an author convention separate from the sidecar's own audit trail.

released.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime when this node was officially released (distinct from `created` / `updated`).

tags.description: Free-form taxonomy tags. Consumed by `sm list --tag <name>` and UI faceted search.

keywords.description: Search keywords. Consumed by full-text search (post-v0.5.0).

icon.description: Display icon (emoji, PrimeIcon code, etc.). UI surface only; no semantic meaning.

color.description: Display color (CSS color name, hex, or design-system token). UI surface only.

priority.description: Display priority (lower-first by convention). UI sort hint; no semantic meaning.

hidden.description: When true, the node is excluded from default listings (still appears under `--all` / `--include-hidden`). Useful for in-progress nodes the author does not want surfaced yet.

docsUrl.description: Canonical docs URL for this node (separate from `source`, which points at the file's upstream).

readme.description: Either a path (relative to scope root) or a URL pointing at this node's README. UI surface; no semantic meaning.

examplesUrl.description: URL of an examples page or directory associated with this node. UI surface; no semantic meaning.

github.description: GitHub handle, repo (`owner/name`), or full URL of the canonical GitHub presence for this node's author or origin. UI surface.

homepage.description: Author or project homepage URL. UI surface.

linkedin.description: LinkedIn handle or full profile URL of the canonical author. UI surface.

twitter.description: Twitter / X handle (with or without leading `@`) or full profile URL. UI surface.
